# Brolytics Technologies
> Crafting Digital Excellence — Enterprise Custom Software, High-Performance Web Applications, Mobile Apps, and Autonomous AI Solutions.

## Overview
Brolytics Technologies is a modern technology engineering agency founded in India with a global footprint (serving clients in India, USA, UK, UAE, Australia, and Canada). We partner with high-growth startups and established enterprises to design, build, and deploy production-grade digital software systems.

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Website Development
- URL: https://brolyticstechnologies.com/services/website-development
- Focus: High-performance corporate websites, Next.js web applications, e-commerce stores, and headless CMS integrations.
- Tech Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Vercel, Supabase, PostgreSQL.

### 2. Mobile App Development
- URL: https://brolyticstechnologies.com/services/mobile-app-development
- Focus: Scalable cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android, native Swift/Kotlin modules, offline-first architectures.
- Tech Stack: React Native, Flutter, Swift, Kotlin, Firebase, SQLite.

### 3. Custom Software Development
- URL: https://brolyticstechnologies.com/services/custom-software-development
- Focus: Enterprise ERPs, CRMs, multi-tenant SaaS platforms, internal business automation, and distributed microservices.
- Tech Stack: Node.js, Go, Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS.

### 4. AI Solutions & LLM Agents
- URL: https://brolyticstechnologies.com/services/ai-services
- Focus: Enterprise Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), autonomous LLM agents, custom fine-tuning, workflow automation.
- Tech Stack: OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude 3.5, Google Gemini, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pinecone, FastAPI.

### 5. UI/UX & Graphic Design
- URL: https://brolyticstechnologies.com/services/graphics-design
- Focus: Interactive Figma prototypes, atomic design systems, product UX audits, and digital brand identity.
- Tools: Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, Framer.

### 6. SEO & Digital Marketing
- URL: https://brolyticstechnologies.com/services/seo-and-digital-marketing
- Focus: Technical SEO audits, Core Web Vitals optimization, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and ROI-driven PPC campaigns.
